a: Observing time on the 100-m Effelsberg radio telescope, judged by the Effelsberg Program Committee on scientific merit and feasibility, and submitted through NorthStar. MPIfR offers support with preparation, observing and data analysis.
dt: Next deadline 1 March 2027 (stated in the September 2026 Effelsberg Newsletter); last deadline was 1 Sep 2026, 15:00 UT. ToO/DDT requests are possible at any time.
e: MPIfR's regular call for the Effelsberg 100-m single dish. 'Access to the telescope is open to all qualified astronomers', and use by scientists from outside MPIfR is encouraged.
f: Max Planck Institute for Radio Astronomy (MPIfR)
n: Effelsberg 100-m Radio Telescope Call for Proposals (1 March 2027 deadline)
unv: The March 2027 call text is not yet released; the date and time of day are from the September 2026 newsletter. MPIfR's general astronomers page still lists an older schedule of three deadlines a year (1 Feb, 1 Jun, 1 Oct), which conflicts with the newsletter. Grad-student PI status was not checked.
